title: [DEV] Autosens is shown on Overview even if disabled
symptom: Autosens data is always drawn on the overview screen as 'active', even when isAutosensModeEnabled() returns false. The icon with percentage value is shown even when autosens is disabled, instead of the X-mark icon that was previously used.
cause: The condition in the code that determines when to show the autosens icon is erroneous; it draws the icon regardless of the isAutosensModeEnabled() state, because the second part of the condition makes no sense.
fix: The issue was resolved in a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/0ef3d9b3757cc3b983132cae832d04cb51180395
